title: Interpretation Mistakes
summary: Correct data + wrong interpretation = wrong decision

sections.heading: Orientation — Beginning of the Lesson
sections.subtitle: Beginning of the Lesson
sections.contentMarkdown: - **What Will You Understand?** The data is correct — the decision is wrong if you interpret it incorrectly.
bullets: **What Will You Understand?** The data is correct — the decision is wrong if you interpret it incorrectly.

sections.heading: Core Idea — 4 Traps
sections.subtitle: 4 Traps
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Correlation** ≠ Causation
- Small sample — 3 clients is not the 'market'
- **Vanity Metric** — Likes ≠ Sales
- Recency bias — The last week is not the whole story
